programme: A HOX-cluster developmental/epigenetic module (HOXA4, HOXA5, HOXA13, HOXB2, HOXB3, HOXC9) moving in concert across nearly all patient groups, coupled to two effector arms: FOSL1 (AP-1/Fra-1)-driven inflammatory ECM remodeling (targets MMP1/2/9/13, CCL2, CXCL8, IL6, PLAUR, NOS3, ELN) and TCF7-marked T-cell programming (IFNG, IL17A, IL2, CD4), with SRSF2 acting as a splicing node (AURKA/B, SRSF1/7, and documented control of tau exon-10 inclusion).
role_in_a: In Alzheimer's disease, HOX-cluster genes are recurrently reported as abnormally expressed/methylated in neurodegeneration and used as peripheral epigenetic-age markers; SRSF2 sits in the documented tau exon-10 splicing pathway (via SIRT1/SC35) and in spliceosome pathology tracking disease progression; FOSL1 is linked to neuroinflammatory and oxidative-stress signaling in AD models; TCF7 marks a CD8+ T-cell population reported to accumulate in AD brain.
role_in_b: In cardiovascular disease, no factor in this set has a retrieved paper or an Open Targets association in the material provided. The inference for a role here rests entirely on target-set architecture: FOSL1's targets (MMP1/2/9/13, CCL2, PLAUR, IL6, NOS3, ELN) are the canonical atherosclerotic plaque remodeling/vascular inflammation gene set, TCF7 marks the same naive/effector T-cell axis implicated in plaque T-cell infiltration, and HOX-cluster methylation is the same kind of peripheral-blood biological-age signal used in cardiovascular risk clocks — but none of this is evidenced for CVD in the retrieved record.
shared_axis: Coordinated HOX-cluster methylation drift is a recognized substrate of epigenetic aging clocks measured in blood, and accelerated biological aging is an independently documented risk axis for both Alzheimer's disease and cardiovascular disease; FOSL1/AP-1 inflammatory remodeling and TCF7-marked immune skewing would be the tissue-specific effector arms translating that shared aging signal into neuroinflammation/tau pathology in brain versus vascular ECM degradation in artery.
reasoning: The module is nameable (HOX-cluster co-regulation plus an AP-1/Wnt-TCF effector arm) and several of its members are independently placed in Alzheimer's disease by retrieved papers, but not a single retrieved paper or Open Targets record places any of these factors in cardiovascular disease, so the cross-disease link is carried by domain reasoning about shared biological aging rather than by anything retrieved. The near-ceiling concordance of the HOX genes (up to 64/64) argues the co-regulation itself is real, but that is a statement about the data-driven network, not about disease sharing.
support: PMID 34654479 — peripheral blood DNA methylation tracks AD progression, consistent with HOXA4 as a methylation-age marker; PMID 28660252 — abnormal homeobox gene expression reported directly in a neurodegeneration cohort (C9ORF72 expansion carriers); PMID 40244264 and PMID 40148430 — epigenomic/methylation-based diagnostic frameworks for AD placing HOXA5 in that context; PMID 40122679 and PMID 36989381 — spliceosome/SRSF pathology tracked through AD progression in entorhinal-hippocampal circuitry; PMID 29226865 — SIRT1 deacetylation of SC35/SRSF2 controls tau exon-10 inclusion, a direct mechanistic AD link; PMID 39349220, 39594444, 37775708 — FOSL1 tied to oxidative-stress/interleukin signaling and endothelial-metabolic overlap in AD; PMID 41794902 — TCF7 marks a CD8+ T-cell population accumulating in AD. None found for cardiovascular disease for any factor.
how_to_falsify: Profile DNA methylation at the HOXA4/HOXA5/HOXA13/HOXB2/HOXB3/HOXC9 loci (e.g., via a Horvath/GrimAge-style clock) in matched blood samples from AD and CVD cohorts, and RNA/protein levels of FOSL1 target genes (MMP9, IL6, CCL2, PLAUR) and TCF7 target genes (IFNG, IL17A) in the same samples; if HOX methylation age acceleration does not correlate between the AD and CVD cohorts, or if FOSL1/TCF7 target activity does not co-vary with that HOX signature, the proposed shared aging-axis account fails.
caveats: Blood/brain tissue pairing means the HOX-methylation-clock interpretation is native to the blood side and extrapolated to brain; 64 patient-group comparisons come from only 6 independent cohort pairs, so the concordance counts are not 64 independent replications. Exclusion of ERG, IRF8, RELB, SPIB, PRDM1, VDR, NFATC2, AR, TFE3 as tissue-generic removes the obvious 'generic endothelial/immune master regulator' story, which is why the account had to be built from HOX/AP-1/Wnt-TCF factors instead — but that also means the account leans on a much less directly evidenced axis. Single-view exclusions (HIVEP3, TFE3, SIRT1, SOX10, ZNF571, E2F2, VDR, HNF4G, DMBX1, IRF8) confirm this story is not built on one subgroup's idiosyncratic top hit.
